title: TQFT context
html:
Remark. TQFT context

The axioms of the quantum universe and quantum observable universe are grounded in topological quantum field theory. The Frobenius--Hopf object A carries the 2d cobordism data and the Hopf structure for quantum-group symmetry. The precise form of the 2d-cobordism claim is the canonical isomorphism \mathbf{Cob}(2) \cong \mathbf{Cob}(3)_{S^2,\mathrm{CF}} [li2026-two-sphere] (Thm.~1.0.8): the commutative-Frobenius part of the S^2-sector of the oriented 3d bordism category is the 2d cobordism category, so Z(S^2) is a commutative Frobenius monoid for every 3d TFT Z, and its Frobenius structure is exactly the 2d cobordism data. The sector's remaining generators, one unit per closed oriented irreducible prime 3-manifold (Thm.~1.0.5), are not used by these axioms. The identification is at the level of the Frobenius structure only: Li's monoids are commutative in a symmetric monoidal target, whereas A is a Hopf algebra in a braided category and is not assumed commutative, and nothing here identifies A with Z(S^2) of a 3d TFT or bears on the Hopf half of the Frobenius--Hopf object.

The condition \mathrm{Hom}_{\mathbf{C}}(\mathbf{1}, \mathrm{Ad}(A)) = 0 acts as the categorical contact condition. It ensures irreducibility of the associated 3d TQFT, non-degeneracy of the pairing across cobordisms, and full dualisability. In the archimedean realisation, this enforces H^0(M, \mathrm{Ad}(P)) = 0, eliminating infinitesimal automorphisms on the instanton connection.
